name: Felice Hawley
title: Editor, writer and content strategist
bio_short: Editor, writer and content strategist with in-depth experience of economic and business news. 16-year career at CNN creating and producing World Business Today. Content design roles at Transport for London, Inviqa and Episerver. UK-based.
bio: Felice is an editor, writer and content strategist with in-depth experience of economic and business news. During a 16-year career at CNN, she helped create and then produce the award-winning live business programme World Business Today. Moving into text-based media, Felice became Managing Editor of Hoover's Online Europe, responsible for a team of journalists covering European business. She has since worked as a content designer and strategist for Transport for London and digital experience platform Episerver, and as an editorial trainer at technology consultancy Inviqa.  Her career bridges broadcast, digital and print media, giving her a comprehensive understanding of how content works across different formats and platforms. Her content design expertise adds a distinctive dimension: she understands not just how to write well, but how to structure content for digital audiences, improve readability and align editorial strategy with user needs.  At ISOC, Felice delivers writing, editing and content programmes. She helps professionals improve their business writing, develop corporate storytelling skills and create content strategies that work across digital and traditional channels. Her CNN experience gives her a rigorous editorial standard, while her content design work brings contemporary best practice in plain English, information architecture and digital communication. Felice is based in the UK and trains in English.

Her content design expertise adds a distinctive dimension: she understands not just how to write well, but how to structure content for digital audiences, improve readability and align editorial strategy with user needs at scale. She has managed content projects for organisations with thousands of pages, dozens of internal content owners and hundreds of devolved authors.  At ISOC, Felice delivers writing, editing and content programmes. She helps professionals improve their business writing, develop corporate storytelling skills and create content strategies that work across digital and traditional channels. Her content design work brings contemporary best practice in plain English, information architecture and audience-centred communication. She is particularly effective with participants who produce written content as part of their professional role. Felice is based in the UK and trains in English.
